name: wazap
description: WhatsApp for your agent: chats, messages, media, contacts and groups behind MCP tools.
long_description: Links your own WhatsApp account as a linked device and exposes it to Claude: read the inbox, catch up on a group, find the invoice someone sent, and send a message once you have approved it. Built on Baileys, over the WhatsApp multi-device protocol. Link the account once from a terminal with `npx wazap-mcp login`; this bundle then talks to that session.

read_only.title: Read-only
read_only.description: Refuse every write. The tools that send, edit, delete or change a group are not registered at all, so Claude cannot message anyone from your number. Untick to let it send after you approve.

data_dir.title: Data directory
data_dir.description: Where wazap keeps credentials, history and media. Leave this alone unless you linked with a WAZAP_DATA_DIR of your own; empty means ~/.wazap.
